alternate_names: Smt. Kanta Devi Raj Rajeshwari Mandir

history.summary: Local Shakti shrine dedicated to Goddess Raj Rajeshwari (a form of Tripura Sundari/Durga), located on Banasar Bagh Road near Nagan Baba, Sangrur, Punjab. Also rendered in a video listing as 'Smt. Kanta Devi Raj Rajeshwari Mandir Sangrur' (Kanta Devi likely the trustee or donor — unverified). Rated 4.8/5 on a review aggregator (28 reviews) as a Hindu temple; hours listed 5:00 AM-8:00 PM daily. NO published history, founding date, or trust information found in public sources — thin record; treat as provisional. Not to be confused with the Raj Rajeshwari Mandir at Dokhar Kaluahi, Madhubani (Bihar), already in this dataset as id raj-rajeshwari-mandir-dokhar-kaluahi. CSV CORRECTION: the CSV 'state' column holds 'Sangrur' (a town/district, not a state); actual state is Punjab.
